theme: Clean Light/Professional SaaS look with Gold accents & Optional Executive Dark Toggle

design_philosophy.vibe: High-trust, ultra-refined, precise, revenue-driving. Combines Swiss structure with subtle liquid-gold metallic accents and crisp optical typography.
principles: Gold as Signal, Not Slop: Use gold (#D4AF37 / #E5C158 / #C5A059) strictly for key interactions, high-value metrics, AI badges, and active focus states. 90% of the UI remains pristine crisp white and warm slate.
Density with Breathing Room: High data correlation for leads and pipeline, padded generously with p-6/p-8 containers and 1px crisp borders (border-slate-200/60).
AI Command Centricity: Every screen provides seamless access to the AI Assistant via Ctrl+K command bar and natural language prompts.
Multi-tenant Isolation: Workspace switcher, API credential vault cards, and tenant brand customization prominently visible.

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900

navigation_sidebar.header: Logo 'GOLD-e' with shimmering gold gradient icon badge and workspace selector dropdown.
navigation_sidebar.footer: User profile pill, API usage bar (e.g. $14.20 / $50 OpenAI limit), Dark/Light toggle button.

components: AI Command Bar Button ('Ctrl + K' shortcut trigger with glowing gold sparkles)
Quick Action Menu (+ New Lead, + Launch Campaign, + Draft Invoice)
Omnichannel Live Status Pill (Meta WhatsApp: Connected, SMTP: Ready, OpenAI: Active)
Tenant Workspace Picker ('Acme Corp - Enterprise Tier')

dashboard_analytics.kpi_grid: 4 cols (Total Revenue Generated, AI Hot Leads Converted, Omnichannel Message Volume, Avg Response Time)
dashboard_analytics.charts_section: 2 cols (Lead Acquisition Trend - Area Chart with Gold Gradient Fill + Conversion Funnel & AI Usage Breakdown)
dashboard_analytics.ai_cost_tracker: Real-time OpenAI & Meta WhatsApp API cost meter with budget alert threshold.

lead_engine.contact_vault_privacy: Toggle to mask sensitive phone numbers/emails for sub-users with RBAC permissions.

sales_pipeline.card_details: Lead Name, Deal Value ($), Channel Badge, AI Sentiment Score, One-click WhatsApp message trigger.

unified_inbox.layout: 3-Pane Layout (Thread List -> Active Chat Workspace -> Lead Detail Context Sidepanel)
features: Channel Switcher Tabs (All, WhatsApp Meta, Email, SMS)
AI One-Click Reply Suggestions (Generate Close Deal Response, Follow-up, Objection Handling)

ai_marketing_studio.layout: Prompt Bar & Creator Sidebar + Asset Grid Gallery
features: Poster & Social Media Graphic Generator (Aspect ratio presets: 1:1 Instagram, 9:16 Story, 16:9 Banner)
AI Ad Caption Generator with Tone selection (Persuasive, Luxury, Urgency, Casual)
Sample Generated Creatives preview with instant export or Send to Campaign button

ai_command_center.type: Global Floating Command Modal (Ctrl+K) & Inline AI Agent Panel
capabilities: "Find hot leads from last week and start a WhatsApp campaign"
"Generate a quote for Acme Corp for 500 licenses"
"Check API costs for OpenAI this month"

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, inputs, buttons, tables, badges, and modals MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="lead-score-hot-badge", data-testid="ai-command-input", data-testid="pipeline-card-drag-handle").
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: All text elements meet WCAG AA / APCA standards. Accent text in gold (#B8860B or #997A15) on light backgrounds; #F5D77F on dark sidebar backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent.component_structure: Use clean Modular React components with Tailwind CSS and Lucide Icons or Phosphor Icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Include rich mock data and interactive React state so all tabs, Modals, Kanban drag/drop, AI generators, and Search filters work live for demo.
instructions_to_main_agent.no_transparent_overlays: Ensure dropdown menus, modals, and tooltips have solid backgrounds (bg-white or bg-slate-900 with shadow-2xl), NEVER fully transparent.
instructions_to_main_agent.micro_interactions: Add smooth hover transformations, active states, active tab indicator transitions, and toast notifications via sonner.
